mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.name, s.description, s.owner_id, s.created_at, s.updated_at, my.role AS my_role, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM space_member sm WHERE sm.space_id = s.id) AS member_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document d WHERE d.space_id = s.id AND d.deleted = 0) AS doc_count FROM space s JOIN space_member my ON my.space_id = s.id AND my.user_id = #{userId} WHERE s.deleted = 0 ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC
